title: IN WHICH PASSEPARTOUT RECEIVES A NEW PROOF THAT FORTUNE FAVORS THE BRAVE
summary_hover: Fogg and his companions attempt to rescue Aouda, ultimately succeeding when Passepartout poses as the resuscitated rajah and carries her away.
summary_detail: Phileas Fogg, Sir Francis Cromarty, Passepartout, and their Parsee guide plot to rescue the young widow, Aouda, from being burned alive. After an attempt to break into the pagoda fails, they wait until dawn when the sacrifice begins. In a daring move, Passepartout secretly takes the place of the deceased rajah on the pyre, rises as if from the dead, and carries the drugged woman to safety before the guards realize the trick.
